summary: Iteration 98: tested Admin template list Sort/Filter, editable Ship's Log help, Passage folders (group/rename/ungroup/undo/persist), Fold a year (nested year>passage>logs), Batch Magic Scan Paper Logs (real Gemini OCR, 2 calls total), crew read-only folders, regression (tick/edit/delete/add logs, Export Current, Email Ship's Log 200, 390px no overflow). Backend 10/10 pytest pass. All requested flows work end to end. Found 1 functional UX bug (Open/Close all label), export/email ignores folder structure, and a few design issues. Fixed 1 trivial CSS bug (search icon overlapping text in template-list-search).

minor.issue: title is optional server-side (Form default ''), only the frontend requires it; date may also be empty. Consider requiring both (min_length=1) to match the UI contract.
Hard cap .to_list(200): as the list keeps growing (the reason for this feature), lists beyond 200 silently disappear from the admin page and from the filter count. /api/admin-lists has the same cap.

Ship's Log PDF/email has no folder awareness: passage/year folder rows are rendered as ordinary tickable entries, no nesting/indent, and logs added to a folder later (e.g. paper scan rows folded into an existing 2024 folder) print at the end of the list, outside their folder.

ui_bugs.issue: Label uses anyOpen = any folder with open:true, including folders hidden inside a CLOSED parent. After folding a year whose passage folder was open, every visible folder is closed yet the button says 'Close all folders'; first tap closes (no visible change), second tap opens. Base anyOpen on visible (non-hidden) folders, or on top-level folders.
Same as email: folder rows print as checkbox items in flat array order; contents not grouped/indented under their folder; order not the arranged display order (arrangeLog).

issues: Rename/Ungroup icon buttons (icon-btn) on the dark navy year folder render in muted grey: low contrast; give them text-white/hover style when item.folder==='year'
'2024 Ship's Logs - 2 entries' counts direct children only (1 passage folder + 1 log) although it holds 4 logs; consider showing total logs or 'N passages, M logs'

design_issues.screen: Group a passage / Batch Magic Scan dialogs
issues: From/To and per-page date use native <input type=date> instead of the shadcn Calendar picker

Search box is cramped (placeholder truncated to 'Search lis') beside the sort select; list names truncate heavily ('Admin - Boa...') so similar Admin - lists are indistinguishable; consider stacking search and sort or wrapping names
Cancel/close after pages were scanned discards the OCR text (Magic uses already spent) with no confirm
On daily_limit 429 the loop keeps trying every remaining page (each fails with 'Daily Magic limit reached.' and fires the top-up event); stop the loop on the first daily_limit

action_items: Fix log-folders-all-btn label: compute anyOpen from visible folders (rows where !hidden) so the label matches what the user sees
Make Ship's Log Export Current/PrintView and the emailed PDF folder-aware (use arrangeLog order, render folder rows as headings without a checkbox, indent contents)
Raise contrast of rename/ungroup icons on the navy year folder row

Optional: year folder count showing total logs; require title on paper-log endpoint; remove/raise 200 cap on /api/admin/template-lists; stop batch scan on daily_limit; confirm before discarding scanned pages
critical_code_review_comments: useLogFolders.anyOpen = folders.some(f => f.open) ignores nesting -> stale Open/Close label (reproduced).
PrintView.jsx and backend render_items have no `folder`/`in` handling; folder rows become ordinary log entries in PDF/email.
TemplateListsAdmin: `.field-input` padding in App.css overrode Tailwind `pl-9` so the search icon overlapped typed text; fixed with `!pl-9`.

Sync debounce is 700 ms (useBoatStore): changes made <1 s before closing the tab without localStorage persist only locally; not a bug on a real device but explains flaky 'did not persist' observations in automation (wait >=2 s before reload).
PassageGroupDialog start/end options include existing passage folders, so a passage folder can be grouped into another passage folder (passage-in-passage); probably acceptable but not documented.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass; 1 label bug + export/print folder handling)

rca of the issue: Open/Close-all label: useLogFolders returns anyOpen: folders.some(f => f.open) over all folders; foldYear creates the year folder closed but leaves the inner passage folder open:true, so anyOpen stays true while nothing is visibly open. Repro: group logs into a passage, open it, Fold a year -> button reads 'Close all folders' with everything collapsed. Fix: anyOpen = rows.some(r => !r.hidden && r.item.folder && r.item.open).
